title: Read the supplied cooperative scheduler
description: You can follow each task's next yield through the given round-robin loop.

steps.description: task_a prints three indexed steps and task_b prints four. Both yield after each message.
scheduler creates the generators and builds a fresh survivor list for each round.

steps.question: Does a generator that raises StopIteration enter next_round?
steps.answer: No. Only generators that reach another yield are appended.

steps.description: The supplied loop resumes each active generator once per round. Completion prints a message and removes that generator from later rounds.
The recording alternates task_a and task_b through step 2. task_b then prints its extra step before the final completion message.
